name: Confirmation charges the cart total
description: The receipt must itemise subtotal, discount, shipping and total, and charge the cart total.

planSteps.description: On the shop page, click "Add to cart" for Speckled Mug once
Click the Cart link in the store header
Type SAVE10 into the Promo code field and click Apply
The order summary shows Subtotal $18.50, Discount -$1.85, Shipping $6.00 and Total $22.65
Fill Full name with Ada Lovelace, Email with ada@example.com, Street address with 12 Analytical St and Postal code with SW1A 1AA, then click Place order
The confirmation page says Order placed
The receipt on the confirmation page lists a Subtotal of exactly $18.50
The receipt lists a Discount of exactly -$1.85
The receipt lists Shipping of exactly $6.00
The Total charged amount reads exactly $22.65
